scope: Separate the public Eq. (4.1) coordinate-valid h interval, the narrower theorem-specialized h regime, and the autonomous numerical h chosen by a callable Eq. (4.5) candidate.
truth_boundary: The interval 0<h<1/2 governs the Eq. (4.1) coordinate branch used by the callable leading-field evaluator.
The narrower h<0.01 condition is a source-scoped theorem regime and is not required merely to serialize or call an autonomous visualization candidate.
A candidate's chosen numerical h remains autonomous_design even when it happens to lie inside the theorem regime.
Matching the theorem h range does not identify the hidden OpenAI profiles, validate Navier-Stokes, establish visual correspondence, or prove paper exactness or blow-up.
